description: Accounting & Bookkeeping page sections: hero, the two icon-card grids (“Switching to Think SME” and “The Same Firm”), pricing packages, what determines your price, the “Why SMEs come to us” bento, the accounting requirements rail, the shared Google Reviews slider, the shared FAQ and the final CTA. The testimonials_*, faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the other pages’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php, faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. Leave a field empty to keep the design’s own copy — the theme treats an empty value as "use the default", so clearing this brings the design text back rather than removing it.
